purpose: Define layer ownership from current package, token and Storybook surfaces without treating historical WDS provenance as live authority.

compatibilityProjections.note: ownerLayer fields under references/wds are checked projections retained beside provenance; they do not decide current ownership.

ownerExceptions.title: LDS/Directory
ownerExceptions.reason: The directory is global navigation maintained with Core documentation infrastructure, not a second runtime layer.

domainDecisions.owns: Generic action, confirmation and lifecycle-presentation primitives.
domainDecisions.excludes: Command eligibility, approval, execution, transport and completion truth remain in the product application.

domainDecisions.owns: Reusable product identity and destination-navigation composition.
domainDecisions.excludes: Routes, permissions, current destination and product information architecture remain in the product application.
Document commands, persistence, renderer lifecycle and product workflow remain in the product application or specialist renderer.

domainDecisions.owns: Renderer-neutral numeric, unit, connection and freshness presentation.
domainDecisions.excludes: Telemetry truth, thresholds, freshness calculation, transport and robot semantics remain in the product application or Robotics layer.

domainDecisions.owns: Reusable equipment identity, state-fact and action-slot anatomy.
domainDecisions.excludes: Equipment state machines, direction, command and transport truth remain in the product application.

domainDecisions.owns: Renderer-neutral viewport frame, state placement and viewport-local controls.
domainDecisions.excludes: Navigation graph meaning, robot pose, spatial safety semantics, renderer lifecycle and transport remain outside this Product family.

domainDecisions.owns: Robot-specific authority, arm, dead-man, safety release and robot operational-state presentation.
domainDecisions.excludes: Actual robot command execution, transport, policy and outcome truth remain in the product application and runtime.

domainDecisions.owns: Robot navigation coordinates, graph adapters, pose, route, trajectory, facility and spatial-domain presentation semantics.
domainDecisions.excludes: Generic application navigation and renderer-neutral viewer chrome remain Product-owned; planning and transport remain in the application/runtime.
